⭐每日小题⭐

答案发群里哈


1⃣️ The technology company has ______ a tracking system that will help us determine the schedule of all incoming shipments.

(A) drawn

(B) devised

(C) dreamed

(D) destined


2⃣️ The term “battery” is often ______ to any device that generates an electric current by a chemical reaction.

(A) applied

(B) used

(C) placed

(D) named

  1. (B) devised

    • "Devised" means to plan or invent (a complex procedure, system, or mechanism) by careful thought. This fits the context of a technology company creating a tracking system.

    • (A) "Drawn" means to create a picture or to pull something.

    • (C) "Dreamed" means to experience dreams while sleeping, or to imagine.

    • (D) "Destined" means fated or intended for a particular purpose.

  2. (A) applied

    • "Applied to" is the most appropriate phrasal verb here, meaning that the term "battery" is used in reference to or in connection with such devices.

    • (B) "Used to" would generally be followed by an infinitive verb (e.g., "used to generate"). While "used" alone could work in some contexts, "applied to" is more precise for defining a term.

    • (C) "Placed to" is grammatically incorrect in this context.

    • (D) "Named to" is also grammatically incorrect here. One might say "named after" or "named as."
